$comment: Single source of truth for the Sidebar API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: An app's side navigation, in groups, that folds down to icons and slides in from the edge on phones.
thumb: PlatformDashboardInboxSettings

SidebarLayout.description: Holds the sidebar and the page beside it. Collapsed shows only the icons.

Sidebar.description: The navigation. On screens under 768px wide it's hidden and the trigger slides it in.

SidebarMenu.description: A list of items outside a group, e.g. in the header or footer.

SidebarGroup.description: A heading and its list of items.

SidebarItem.description: A link. active marks the current page. Give it an icon so it still shows when folded.

SidebarSub.description: An item that opens a nested list.

SidebarTrigger.description: Folds the sidebar to icons, or opens it on phones.

SidebarInset.description: The page next to the sidebar.

--vin-sidebar-width / --vin-sidebar-min-.description: Open width (16rem) and the layout's height (100dvh).

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Groups, a current page, a count and a nested list. The button folds it to icons; on a phone it slides the sidebar in. In HTML, add data-vin-sidebar and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Folded to icons
examples.description: Starts folded. Each link keeps its name for screen readers and shows it as a tooltip.

a11y: A nav landmark with its own name. Each group is a list named by its heading.
The current page is marked with aria-current="page".
The trigger is a button with aria-controls and aria-expanded, so screen readers hear whether the sidebar is open.
Folded, the text is hidden visually but still read out, and shown as a tooltip on hover.
On phones it opens above the page: Escape or a tap outside closes it, and focus goes back to the trigger.
